sample_design: At most 100 eligible pages per year; round-robin allocation across newspaper-series/year strata; seeded hash selection within each stratum.
eligibility: At least 200 ASCII wordlike tokens in RevX OCR, or original CA OCR as fallback. Exact duplicate page keys and identical text for the same series/date/page are excluded. This is a length screen, not verified OCR accuracy.

paired_ocr_length_check.ratio_definition: RevX ASCII-wordlike-token count divided by original CA OCR count, on pages with at least 200 in both fields.
paired_ocr_length_check.interpretation: Differences can reflect OCR corrections, errors, omissions, summarization or other processing. These ratios are not a measured error rate.
